_comment: Development trust anchors for board-discovery signature verification (spec 17 §6). The `partner` key is the recipe dev partner key (device_discovery/tool/dev_keys) that signs the posix-tcp dev node; `marketplace` mirrors AppPlayer Pro's dev root. These are DEV anchors — a production build replaces this asset with the real root CAs. Signature enforcement is off by default (Settings → Auto discovery → Require signed boards).
